mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing future cash flow valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 50,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% triggers a risk-on equity response as investors anticipate sustained job growth, lifting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 100 signals a robust US manufacturing cycle, which reduces the risk premium on equities and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in robust periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000K units indicates healthy consumer demand, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and lifting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals a weakening supply side, which amplifies demand-side pressures and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weak periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is likely to hold rates steady, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in moderate-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
